response.original_title: The Making of Uncharted 4 : A Thief’s End
response.overview: A documentary exploring the making of Uncharted 4: A Thief’s End. Featuring insights from the team at Naughty Dog, it takes a behind-the-scenes look at the creative process, technical challenges, storytelling and artistic vision behind one of the studio’s most ambitious adventures.
response.tagline: Behind every great adventure lies an extraordinary creative journey.
response.title: The Making of Uncharted 4 : A Thief’s End
